titre: Avengers: Doomsday Will Officially Bring Back One of the MCU's Best Heroes
chapo: Hailee Steinfeld has been confirmed to return as Hawkeye in December's Avengers: Doomsday as the massive cast continues to grow.
extrait: The Avengers are set to get a little more help in December's Avengers: Doomsday. In an Instagram post on Sunday, Hailee Steinfeld confirmed she would return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe as Kate Bishop/Hawkeye while promoting her new movie Hexed. In the video, she pans to a director's chair with her name on it, like how the Doomsday cast was initially revealed in an hours-long stream last year. On Monday, Nov. 23, Marvel released the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday. It includes a brief shot of Steinfeld's Hawkeye amid the fray. Steinfeld joined the MCU in 2021's Hawkeye, a Disney Plus show heavily inspired by Matt Fraction and David Aja's mid-2010s Hawkeye comics. As a kid, Kate Bishop watched Hawkeye defend New York City during the events of The Avengers, inspiring her to pick up the bow and arrow herself. She later meets Jeremy Renner's Hawkeye in a post-Endgame world, and the pair get up to various shenanigans around Christmas time. She makes an end-credits cameo appearance in 2023's The Marvels as Kamala Khan/Ms. Marvel (Iman Vellani) does her best Nick Fury impression; Khan wants to put together a group of heroes herself. This led to a lot of fan speculation that Marvel might have a Young Avengers project in the works, but Marvel hasn't announced anything like that. However, with Cassie Lang also appearing in Doomsday and Billy and Tommy Maximoff firmly in the MCU, who knows what Marvel is planning for its young heroes next. You'll see Steinfeld as Hawkeye (but not Renner... that we know of), Chris Evans as Steve Rogers, Florence Pugh as Black Widow, and more heroes in Avengers: Doomsday when it hits theaters Dec. 18.

Steinfeld first played Kate Bishop in Disney Plus series Hawkeye, before making a post-credits appearance two years later as Kamala Khan began recruiting for a new, younger team in The Marvels. Since then, there have been plenty of rumblings about Young Avengers turning up in full force around Avengers: Doomsday. Kathryn Newton's Cassie Lang is part of the cast, but no other prospective or rumored members are currently confirmed for the crossover movie. The likes of Wiccan, Speed, and Ms. Marvel have been shown in concept art that did the rounds last year. And, hey, we need to see what happened to Hulk's son too, right? There's no sign of Kate Bishop's mentor Hawkeye stringing up his bow anytime soon, however. Hawkeye actor Jeremy Renner posted a cryptic tease on Instagram back in August – so it seems there are plenty more secrets left for Doomsday to tell. titre: Kate Bishop Actress Hailee Steinfeld Confirmed for Avengers: Doomsday
chapo: Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday.
extrait: Marvel Studios has confirmed Kate Bishop actress Hailee Steinfeld as a last-minute addition to the cast of Avengers: Doomsday. Marvel Studios announced the surprise return of Hawkeye's Disney+ partner in a nonchalant Instagram reel tonight. Serving as promotion for Steinfeld's other new Disney movie, Hexed, the video sees her jokingly say someone delivered a chair "from a different movie," but the post's caption makes things pretty clear. "Catch Hailee Steinfeld in Disney's Hexed before she returns in Avengers: Doomsday," the post said. You'd be forgiven for thinking Steinfeld was already included in Doomsday's already enormous lineup of superheroes and A-listers. Everyone from Robert Downey Jr. and Pedro Pascal to Tom Hiddleston has previously been confirmed to make an appearance of some kind, but Steinfeld was one of a few names to have been curiously benched up until this point. She first appeared as the bow-wielding Kate Bishop in the Jeremy Renner-led 2021 show, Hawkeye. Aside from a The Marvels cameo and some animated voice work, Steinfeld hasn't spent too much time in the Marvel Cinematic Universe as the multiverse saga has rolled on. That won't stop her from helping out in the first chapter of its finale, though. With the cast already stacked, it's hard to know just how prominently her character will be featured amongst the chaos. Between the Avengers, the New Avengers, Fantastic Four, and X-Men, there will likely be little room to explore how she gets along with the rest of the crew. For many, just the fact that she'll help in the fight against Doctor Doom is probably enough. Avengers: Doomsday premieres December 18, 2026. That's a little less than one month away, but Marvel's made it clear that it's saved plenty of surprises. Another major MCU name was teased for the movie when VisionQuest wrapped up earlier this month. Fans are expecting at least one more trailer to drop between now and the film's premiere, and if Captain Carter actress Hayley Atwell is to be believed, we won't have to wait much longer to see it.
